props.gloss_en: R' Yochanan: famine is one of three things the Holy One proclaims Himself
famine -- as it is written: 'for the Lord has called for a famine' (II Kgs 8:1)
plenty -- as it is written: 'and I will call for the grain and increase it' (Ezek 36:29)
a good leader -- as it is written: 'and the Lord spoke to Moses saying: see, I have called by name Bezalel' (Ex 31:1-2)
R' Yitzchak: one appoints a leader over the community only if one consults the community
as it is said: 'see, the Lord has called by name Bezalel' (Ex 35:30)
the Holy One to Moses: Moses, is Bezalel suitable to you? ... and, on Moses's reply: nevertheless, go tell them
Moses: Master of the world, if he is suitable before You, all the more so before me
Moses went and said to Israel: is Bezalel suitable to you?
Israel: if he is suitable before the Holy One and before you, all the more so before us
R' Yonatan: Bezalel was called by that name on account of his wisdom

Bezalel, when Moses had reversed God's order and told him 'make an ark, vessels and a mishkan': the world's way is to build a house and then bring vessels into it -- where shall I put the vessels I make? perhaps the Holy One told you 'make a mishkan, an ark and vessels'?
Moses: perhaps you were in the shadow of God (betzel El) and knew?
Rav: Bezalel knew how to combine the letters with which heaven and earth were created
R' Yochanan: the Holy One gives wisdom only to one who has wisdom
as it is said: 'He gives wisdom to the wise and knowledge to those who know understanding' (Dan 2:21)
R' Abbahu: you learn it from there; we learn it from here -- 'and in the hearts of all the wise-hearted I have put wisdom' (Ex 31:6)
